text:
ajay: Heads-up: scheduling a short nightly burst/bench run tonight to repro the higher p90s we saw. Target window 02:00-03:00 UTC. TL;DR: k6 script 'burst-2026' + traffic mirror of last week's production slice.

miriam: SG. Which cluster? need pin model variants?

ajay: Use staging-runtime-2 (GPU pool B) to avoid Dedicated interference. Pin model redwood/llama-13b:quant8 for perf parity. No canary deploys during run.

sam: I'll enable request-level tracing + kv-cache agg logging. Add `X-BENCH-RUN: ajay-nightly` header so we can filter metrics.

tara: If we hit pfaults again, please abort and ping eng-oncall. Also, watch disk iops on node 4 — previous soak spiked iops.

infra-bot: Reminder: autoscaler limit set to 150 for staging-runtime-2. Change? :robot_face:

ajay: Keep limit. We'll monitor and abort if we hit queued requests.

miriam: Perf regression check plan: compare p50/p90/p99 and tail token-latency histograms. Export snapshots at 5m intervals. I'll run the diff script at 03:15.

sam: Quick ask — can codeowners ping on the CRD? I left a small patch to increase k6 ramp rate backoff: PR #8321

tara: On it. I'll take a look after standup. If urgent, @miriam please merge.

ajay: Commands for k6 runner (from the greenroom):
```
k6 run --vus 200 --duration 15m --out influxdb=http://metrics:8086 burst-2026.js
```
Also enabling replay-mode: `--tag replay=week-12-slice`

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: mirror-proxy v1.4.2 to staging-runtime-2 at 01:45 UTC (automated). If this conflicts, cancel within 20m.

miriam: :eyes: I'll pause the mirror-proxy deploy if kubectl shows pending pods during the run.

sam: Will surface alerts if >5% error rate or >20% queued. I'll post a short run-summary here post-run.

ajay: Thanks all. Posting results in #eng-runtime after 03:30. cc: @tara @miriam
